title: Software
description: A software product (plugin, DAW, standalone app)

categories.description: Additional categories. Valid values are in schema/categories.yaml. Common synonyms (e.g., 'eq' for 'equalizer') are mapped in schema/category-aliases.yaml. To add a new category, submit a PR updating the schema file.

releaseDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or year-only (YYYY) if releaseDateYearOnly is true.

releaseDateYearOnly.description: Set true if releaseDate is year-only (YYYY format).

primaryCategory.description: Main category for this entry. Valid values are in schema/categories.yaml. Common synonyms (e.g., 'eq' for 'equalizer') are mapped in schema/category-aliases.yaml. To add a new category, submit a PR updating the schema file.

secondaryCategory.description: Optional secondary category. Same valid values as primaryCategory.

supersedes.description: ID (21-char nanoid) of the older product this replaces. Find the ID in the superseded product's YAML file. Use for version upgrades (Pro-C 2 → Pro-C 3) and hardware generations (MKI → MKII).

details.description: Longer product details. Use block scalar '|-' format with paragraphs separated by blank lines.

specs.description: Product specifications. Use block scalar '|-' format with '- ' prefixed list items.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. To add a new currency, update schema/currencies.yaml.

asOf.description: ISO date when price was last verified

type.description: Link type. Valid values are defined in schema/link-types.yaml. To add a new type, submit a PR updating that file.

formats.description: Plugin formats (e.g., au, vst3, aax, clap). Defined in schema/formats.yaml.

identifiers.description: Plugin identifiers keyed by format (e.g., au, vst3)
